description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams' which extends 'FilterParams' and is used for filtering email subscribers with parameters such as enabled status and IDs. It is part of the OrangeHRM HRM system under the admin DTO namespace.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object used for filtering email subscriber records based on enable status and IDs, with a default sort field set to 'emailSubscriber.name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params object and sets the default sort field.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns the enable status filter value.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enable status filter value.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the array of IDs used for filtering.

methods.name: setIds
methods.description: Sets the array of IDs used for filtering.
